server-relay.acme.authzName: The ACME authorization is not for the address being requested
server-relay.acme.noAlpn: This certificate authority offers no TLS-ALPN-01 challenge: through a relay only that one works
server-relay.acme.noNonce: The ACME server gave no nonce
server-relay.acme.notJson: The ACME server's answer is not JSON
server-relay.acme.notPem: The downloaded certificate is not PEM
server-relay.acme.readBroken: The connection broke while reading the ACME server's answer
server-relay.acme.tooLarge: The ACME server's answer is too large
server-relay.acme.urlBad: The {what} URL the ACME server gave is malformed
server-relay.acme.urlMissing: The ACME server gave no {what} URL
server-relay.acme.urlOffOrigin: The {what} URL the ACME server gave is not on its own domain: not connecting
server-relay.binding.noKey: This Daisy has no TLS key yet
server-relay.cert.keyMismatch: The certificate does not match the relay's TLS key
server-relay.cert.keyNotEc: {file} is not an ECDSA private key: move it away and start again to generate a new one
server-relay.cert.note.acme: Certificate issued by a certificate authority: Daisys, third-party A2A clients and browsers can all use it through the relay (third-party clients must trust the relay operator not to obtain a forged certificate)
server-relay.cert.note.selfSigned: Self-signed certificate: through the relay only Daisys can use it (they check the TLS binding claim); third-party A2A clients and browsers report the certificate as untrusted
server-relay.config.acmeBad: The ACME directory URL is malformed
server-relay.config.acmeCredentials: The ACME directory URL may not carry a user name, password or #
server-relay.config.acmeNotHttps: The ACME directory URL must be https
server-relay.config.reservedDomain: {domain} is a reserved domain no certificate authority issues for: self-signed certificate only
server-relay.config.urlCredentials: The relay address may not carry a user name or password
server-relay.config.urlNotDomain: The relay address must be a domain name (not an IP address: the relay gives each Daisy a subdomain)
server-relay.config.urlNotHttps: The relay address must be https
server-relay.config.urlPath: The relay address is only a domain and port, no path
server-relay.link.closed: The connection to the relay closed ({code})
server-relay.link.full: The relay is full and is not taking new Daisys for now
server-relay.link.fullRetry: The relay is full: retrying automatically later
server-relay.link.noHeartbeat: No heartbeat from the relay for a long time: reconnecting
server-relay.link.notAllowed: This relay's operator does not admit this Daisy (it is not on their allow list): choose another relay, or ask the operator to add your identity number to the list
server-relay.link.proofRefused: The relay does not accept this Daisy's registration proof (a relay version mismatch?)
server-relay.link.replaced: The same identity key connected to this relay elsewhere (the same data directory running on two machines?)
server-relay.link.restarting: The relay is restarting: reconnecting automatically later
server-relay.link.tooManyPending: The relay says too many connections are registering from this exit address: retrying automatically later
server-relay.link.wrongWelcome: The relay answered with an identity or address that is not this Daisy's: disconnecting
